Beginner lesson

Make your first sound

Posture, air and a relaxed embouchure.

Getting a sound

Sit or stand tall and relax your shoulders. Bring the flute to your lower lip and blow gently across the hole, like blowing across a bottle.

If your sound is airy, try changing the angle of your breath.

Practice tip

Try each note for four slow counts. Rest, breathe, and try again.

Learn flute

Four lessons, from your first sound to a one-octave scale. Work at your own pace.

Meet B

B sits on the middle line of the treble clef staff.

Reading the staff

The five lines are called the staff. Notes sit on a line or in a space. As notes move higher on the staff, their pitch gets higher too.
